mechanism: Verapamil reduces renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate, decreasing tobramycin clearance and increasing nephrotoxicity risk; tobramycin-induced acute tubular necrosis may be potentiated by verapamil-mediated renal vasoconstriction.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and tobramycin levels closely; consider alternative calcium channel blocker with less renal effect or alternative aminoglycoside; ensure adequate hydration and dose adjustment based on renal function.
